title: Build a small human review workflow
objectives: Test drafts against normal and missing-data cases
Keep human approval separate from generation

quiz.prompt: Which is the most concrete factual review check?

options.text: Every claim is supported by the brief

quiz.prompt: A missing-data test omits the time. What should a draft do?

options.text: Keep the time unknown or request clarification

quiz.prompt: A draft passes formatting but invents a link. What next?

options.text: Correct and recheck the unsupported claim
Ignore facts if the tone is friendly

quiz.prompt: What does a 3/4 checklist result mean here?

options.text: Three listed checks passed for this draft
